items.description: There are so many movies in the world today. How do you find a new movie to watch? Discovr Movies makes it easy to find a new movie that you'll like. The app is an interactive map of the world of movies. It makes it fun to discover new movies to watch. You can navigate through the entire interconnected ecosystem of hundreds of thousands of movies and find new movies that are similar to movies that you like. Discovr Movies is out now for iPhone, iPad, and Mac OSX.
Music and movie discovery web site. Search over 18 million people, albums, movies and songs.

Search for products on: Google, Yahoo, PriceGrabber, Shopzilla, Amazon, Buy.com, etc. and kulist.com will show you price comparisons directly into your current page. Click on a merchant for any product and optionally add the product to your lists. 2%
List of the most endangered destinations in the world, with the threats they are facing.

Track your packages with Google Maps and RSS feeds! Track UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL. PackageMapping.com really works and is free to the public. See where your package is as it makes its way across the map. Check it out and bookmark it!
One page shopping at Amazon. A smarter, quicker way of shopping at Amazon: Search all Amazon international shops, browse and view products all on one page, bookmark products with drag and drop.
This map displays the amount of restaurants by category and neighborhood. Using the Google Maps API, the data is displayed on a map that can easily be navigated by users.
Measure and share real-time local Twitter trends. App uses Twitter, Google Maps and Yahoo Term Extraction APIs.

Simple tools to create MailChimp lead capture forms. Organize multiple forms with various features and fields for each. Send subscribers to multiple lists and groups. Growing those lists is simple and quick with QuickChimp.
VMAP is the mecca for Travel Videos. You can explore the world by browsing videos on a map and you can share your travel videos for others to find.

Information about schools and how you can help classrooms and students are displayed on a map. Choose from DonorsChoose (fundraising for classroom projects), Mentor Pro (volunteering) or Great Schools (school data).
Scovry is a web discovery site that gets data from multiple popular social sources. This data is shown in an easy to follow streaming ticker format.
Racoon The Searcher is search and subscription system that collects information about all government procurement in Russia. In Russian.
A mashup for the ancient Roman road Via Claudia Augusta between Konigsbrunn and Epfach in Germany.
Kent County Council. View road traffic status and live camera feeds in the UK.
View locations made famous in the Seinfeld sitcom. Includes the Soup Nazi, the Diner, and Nathans Coney Island.
Best American hospitals for Cancer Treatment as mentioned in US News.

Developers can use this this mashup to insert a Giphy search bot into their HipChat sessions. Whenever a user types /giphy plus a keyword, the Lucille HipChat Bot will return a Gif that matches the search criteria. Requirements for implementation include the Python HipChat Library.
Free tool to measure the power and authority of a Twitter user.
Google map of TB patient Andrew Speaker's journey across the Atlantic.

LastVid.com brings together YouTube's endless collection of music videos and the power of last.fm's music discovery service. You can also search for your last.fm username to play videos for your favorite songs.
With Call the News you are the local news reporter. Call in and record your news report. Your call is then added to the site within seconds to share with the world.
A single page interface showing Twitter trends for last 24 hours. View latest tweets and why they are trending.
Search for anything instantly. Find tweets, news, videos and products, with results updated instantly.
Dating site that also incorporates YouTube videos.
Online travel blog with Flickr photo integration.
Interactive Map of FCAT Scores by School, District and Zip Code. FCAT Stands for Florida Comprehensive Assessment Test. Uses Google Maps and the MapLarge API
A Chinese wiki service based on Google Maps.
